This product is supplied without battery and charger. DeWalt 5.0ah batteries now on offer! Please see product code 6328D.

Oscillating multi-tool with brushless motor delivering up to 57% more run time over DEWALT brushed motors. All-metal gearing for improved durability and performance. Designed for professional detail sanding, plunge cutting, flush cutting, removal of excess materials and surface preparation applications. Lightweight for easy handling and dual-grip, variable speed trigger provides ultimate speed and application control. Quick-Change accessory system allows blade and attachments to be swapped without the use of tools. Bright LED light illuminates dark work surfaces for accurate cutting. Includes universal accessory adaptor for use with most brands of oscillating tool accessory. Supplied with 13 piece cutting and sanding accessory set. Compatible with DEWALT 18V Li-Ion XR battery system (batteries and charger sold separately).
b: Does Not Include Battery or Charger
